Owala Just Dropped 3 New Holiday Designs, Plus One Exclusive You Might Have Missed

By Britt Franklin | November 3, 2026 | Leave A Comment
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:33
Instaread

Videos by Sporked

If you’re looking to swap out your on-the-go drinkware for the festive season, I’ve got good news: Owala has expanded its Happy Holidays Collection, introducing three new cup designs for those who love hygge, a touch of glam, and winter calm: Sew Merry, Golden Eclipse, and Snow Petal. The new designs draw inspiration from cozy essentials, snowy weather, and whimsical golden accents of the holiday season. You’ll find the new designs on Owala’s FreeSip tumbler, the FreeSip Sway, and the SmoothSip Slider. For those who want to snag a cup for hot coffee or cocoa, check out the SmoothSip Slider, which was built to handle cold and hot beverages.

In case you missed it, Owala also recently released Amazon-exclusive drinkware in two new colorways, Sweet Talk and Punch Line, which incorporates seasonal pink and burgundy shades into sleek stripes. Check out details on each of the new designs below, and let us know your favorite!

Sew Merry, 24-Ounce FreeSip

Inspired by cozy winter quilts, the charming Sew Merry design features a retro patchwork design with holiday motifs. If you look closely enough, you’ll spot Christmas trees, wreaths, snowflakes, holly, and wrapped gifts.

In addition to the Owala FreeSip, Sew Merry is available in the SmoothSip Slider. 

SHOP THE SEW MERRY FREESIP | $34.99

Golden Eclipse, 24-Ounce FreeSip

Elegant and celestial, the Golden Eclipse design features moon phases, a variety of stars, and swirling gold accents that make it feel both magical and mysterious.

In addition to the Owala FreeSip, Golden Eclipse is available in the FreeSip Sway and SmoothSip Slider. 

SHOP THE GOLDEN ECLIPSE FREESIP | $34.99

Snow Petal, 24-Ounce FreeSip

The beauty of a winter chill is captured in the Snow Petal design, which features an all-over field of florals in monochromatic shades of blue.

In addition to the Owala FreeSip, Snow Petal is available in the FreeSip Sway and SmoothSip Slider. 

SHOP THE SNOW PETAL FREESIP | $34.99

Sweet Talk, 32-Ounce FreeSip

If you want to channel the holidays without making it too obvious, Sweet Talk has a pink-forward, candy-striped design that looks really similar to a cherry candy cane.

Sweet Talk is available in the Owala FreeSip (24 and 32 ounces), FreeSip Sway (18 and 30 ounces), and SmoothSip Slider (12 and 20 ounces).

SHOP THE SWEET TALK FREESIP | $32 (NORMALLY $39.99)

Punch Line, 32-Ounce FreeSip

Like Sweet Talk, the Punch Line design also features stripes, but in cooler tones of red and burgundy for a sophisticated vibe.

Punch Line is available in the Owala FreeSip (24 and 32 ounces), FreeSip Sway (18 and 30 ounces), and SmoothSip Slider (12 and 20 ounces).

SHOP THE PUNCH LINE FREESIP | $32 (NORMALLY $39.99)
